premises.text: Managing a digital life across many apps and connected devices by constantly checking a phone is a poor way to get timely information
premises.evidence_span: There should be a nicer way to communicate with technology rather than checking your phone every single minute

premises.text: Glance Clock is a wall clock with glanceable geometric display, speaker, and open cloud platform that shows relevant data from wearables, connected devices, and web services
premises.evidence_span: a well-designed wall clock with embedded glanceable display, built-in speaker, and open cloud platform

premises.text: Glance Cloud integrates via open APIs, analyzes what/when/where to show, and can tailor data by clock location after simple phone pairing
premises.evidence_span: Glance Cloud will analyze this data and understand what information, when, and where to display

premises.text: Market entry via Indiegogo then web pre-orders and retail at about $149, with interchangeable frames for home or office
premises.evidence_span: the estimated price will be just $149 for a single device

value.text: Needed information read quickly at a glance without disrupting current tasks
value.evidence_span: read information quickly at a glance without being disrupted from your current tasks

causal_links.evidence_span: checking your phone every single minute
shows you information from your wearables, connected devices, and web services right at the moment you need it
we will go to retail after the successful shipping

notes: Sleep/weather/calendar demo uses folded as applications of one glanceable integration mechanism (§4.1.2/7). Team bios and community count excluded. Singleton D1/D3 retained. Anti-template: problem, product/cloud, and GTM pricing are separately revisable.
